meta.name: apple-hig-expert
meta.description: Audits and designs iOS/macOS/watchOS/visionOS interfaces against the Apple Human Interface Guidelines, including the Liquid Glass design language (announced WWDC25, shipped with iOS 26/macOS Tahoe, Sept 2025). Use when reviewing an Apple-platform mockup or app for HIG compliance, checking contrast or tap-target sizes, or designing native-feeling Apple UI (e.g., 'audit my iOS app against the HIG', 'is this text readable on Liquid Glass?').

copy.tagline: 对照苹果人机界面指南审核和设计界面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在设计或审核苹果平台应用，需要确保符合 HIG 规范。
